projects.project_description: A downstream flood control structure is being built along Lobo River (Downstream), Phase I, Barangay Lagadlarin, Lobo, Batangas. The project includes the construction of a reinforced concrete dike with a 4-meter crest width and 6-meter height, supported by rubble concrete, steel sheet piles, and a parapet wall. It aims to protect lives and properties from major flooding in the area
